en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a broad, cobblestone public square bordered by buildings and sparse leafless trees. People in period dress, including women in long skirts and children, are walking or standing in the square. The buildings have old-fashioned signage, and the overall scene is tranquil and historical. At the top in red text, it reads 'Grossenhain.' and 'Lindenplatz.'
